title: Malcolm Spellman on How ‘Snowfall’ Spinoff ‘The Drop’ Connects With the Original Series and Why He’s “Not Gonna Chase Cameos”
summary: The showrunner of the FX drama explains his "eyewitness" approach to authenticity in the Gail Bean- and Isaiah John-starring TV show about the rise of West Coast hip-hop in the '90s and why community feedback tells him "this motherf***er is a hit."
